title: Finding the return window
transcript:
Customer: Can I return unopened headphones purchased last week?
Agent: Yes. Unopened items are eligible within thirty days of purchase.
Customer: How do I start?
Agent: Select Return in your order history to get a prepaid label.
Customer: The label downloaded successfully.

key_points: Agent explained the stated policy and customer downloaded a return label; refund not yet completed.
expected.resolution_details: Agent explained the stated policy and customer downloaded a return label; refund not yet completed.
action_items: Customer to send the item using the return label.
